Posture: secure
     to: permissive

Host-wide switches change (the global posture goes secure -> permissive):
  plugin install: review summary and a confirmation on a terminal -> summary printed; --yes skips the confirmation
  changed plugin: refused until re-reviewed -> loaded, with a warning and an audit record
  MCP exposure of plugin operations: only what connector-config.yaml exposes -> every declared operation, narrowed by connector-config.yaml
  mcp-http listen: loopback only -> --insecure-listen allowed, with a warning and an audit record
